name: Stochastic three-policy router + erasing
tagline: Each image is routed at random to TrivialAugmentWide, RandAugment, or identity, then crop/flip/RandomErasing with dataset-tuned probabilities.
diff_from_baseline: Beyond the cutout/randaugment/trivialaugment baselines, mixes all three with an identity branch via a stochastic router and stacks RandomErasing afterwards, with the routing weights and erase probability tuned per dataset.

name: Augmentation pyramid + stochastic depth
tagline: Multi-stage pipeline that randomly samples augmentation intensity per image and randomly drops entire augmentation blocks, plus channel-wise erasing.
diff_from_baseline: Goes well beyond the cutout/randaugment/trivialaugment baselines: stacks rescaling, intensity-bucketed photometric ops, additional rotation/perspective/affine transforms, then a per-channel masking pass with mixed rectangular/disc shapes.

name: Self-augment-mix with structured masks
tagline: Tensor-space self-mix that blends the original image with a strongly augmented copy through a randomly chosen mask: cutmix patch, coarse grid, stripes, MixUp alpha, or per-channel grid.
diff_from_baseline: Replaces single-image cutout/randaugment with a stochastic image-vs-augmented self-mix using five mask shapes (cutmix, coarse multi-grid, stripes, MixUp, channel-decoupled grid) and a final RandomErasing step.

name: TrivialAug + mean-patch + erasing
tagline: TrivialAugmentWide for semantic perturbation, mean-fill patch occlusion in tensor space, plus a small RandomErasing pass; geometry adapts per dataset.
diff_from_baseline: Goes past the trivialaugment baseline by stacking a mean-fill (rather than zero) patch occlusion before normalization plus a low-area RandomErasing pass, with all triggers tuned per dataset and HFlip disabled for FashionMNIST.

name: Stochastic multi-scale erasing + RandAug
tagline: Cutout-style masks at three scales applied stochastically, layered on dataset-tuned RandAugment plus crop/flip/rotation.
diff_from_baseline: Combines RandAugment with a Cutout generalization that applies stochastic masks at three sizes simultaneously and adds a small rotation, with all magnitudes tuned per dataset.
